capabilities.name: Technology Readiness
capabilities.focus: Does the farm understand its operational needs and have the basic infrastructure, resources, willingness and capacity required to identify and adopt appropriate technologies?

capabilities.name: Digital Capability
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer have access to and the practical skills required to confidently use digital technologies in everyday farm and business activities?

capabilities.name: Farm Information & Data Management
capabilities.focus: Does the farm systematically collect, organise, store and maintain reliable information about its production, finances, resources and operations?

capabilities.name: Data-Driven Decision Making
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer actually use farm records, data, digital information and analysis to make better operational, production and business decisions?

capabilities.name: Continuous Improvement & Innovation
capabilities.focus: Does the farm continuously evaluate its performance, experiment with better approaches, adopt appropriate innovations and improve how technology and information are used over time?

capabilities.name: Energy Awarenes & Readiness
capabilities.focus: Does the farm understand its energy situation, needs, challenges and opportunities well enough to make informed energy decisions?

capabilities.name: Renewable Energy & Adoption
capabilities.focus: Has the farm adopted appropriate renewable-energy technologies and integrated them effectively into farm operations?

capabilities.name: Energy Efficiency & Management
capabilities.focus: What energy do I use, where do I use it, what does it cost me, what problems does it create, and where are my biggest opportunities?

capabilities.name: Productive Energy Use & Adoption
capabilities.focus: Is energy being deliberately used to increase productivity, reduce labour, improve quality, reduce losses and create economic value?

capabilities.name: Energy Resilience, Innovation & Continous Growth
capabilities.focus: Can the farm maintain reliable energy access, manage disruptions, adapt to changing needs and continuously improve its energy systems?

capabilities.name: Food Safety Awareness
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer understand food-safety risks, responsibilities and the basic principles required to produce food that is safe for consumers?

capabilities.name: Safe Production Practices
capabilities.focus: Does the farm consistently apply appropriate practices that prevent contamination and protect food safety throughout production, harvesting, handling and storage?

capabilities.name: Product Quality Management
capabilities.focus: Does the farm define, monitor and consistently deliver the product-quality characteristics required by its customers and target markets?

capabilities.name: Compliance, Traceability & Documentation
capabilities.focus: Can the farm demonstrate what was produced, how it was produced, which inputs were used, where the product came from and whether relevant requirements were followed?

capabilities.name: Continuous Improvement & Certification Readiness
capabilities.focus: Does the farm systematically review food-safety, quality and compliance performance, correct weaknesses and progressively prepare to meet recognised standards or certification requirements where commercially relevant?

capabilities.name: Indigenous & Local Knowledge Awareness
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer recognise, understand and value indigenous and locally developed knowledge and its potential contribution to productive, sustainable and climate-resilient farming?

capabilities.name: Climate Risk Awareness & Assessment
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer understand the climate and environmental risks affecting the farm and systematically assess their potential impact on production, resources, infrastructure and the farm business?

capabilities.name: Climate-Smart Farm Practices
capabilities.focus: Does the farm apply appropriate practices that improve its ability to manage climate risks while supporting productivity, sustainability and long-term farm performance?

capabilities.name: Resource Conservation & Ecosystem Resilience
capabilities.focus: Does the farm actively protect and restore the soil, water, biodiversity and ecosystems on which its long-term productivity and resilience depend?

capabilities.name: Adaptation, Innovation & Continuous Improvement
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer continuously learn from changing conditions, test new approaches, combine different knowledge systems and adapt the farm to strengthen long-term climate resilience?

capabilities.name: Financial Literacy & Farm Record Managem
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer understand the basic financial position of the farm and maintain accurate, organised and reliable records that support effective business management?

capabilities.name: Cost, Revenue & Profitability Management
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer understand and actively manage the costs, revenues, margins and profitability of individual farm enterprises and the overall farm business?

capabilities.name: Productivity & Performance Management
capabilities.focus: Does the farm systematically measure how effectively its land, labour, inputs, capital and other resources are being converted into productive and financial results?

capabilities.name: Cash Flow, Planning & Risk Management
capabilities.focus: Can the farm plan its financial needs, maintain sufficient liquidity to operate, anticipate future requirements and prepare for events that could disrupt the business?

capabilities.name: Growth Strategy, Scalability & Continuous Improvement
capabilities.focus: Does the farm have a deliberate strategy, systems and capacity to improve and grow while maintaining or strengthening profitability, efficiency, quality, resilience and sustainability?

capabilities.name: Human Capital Awareness
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer understand that people, skills, knowledge and leadership are critical farm resources and recognise the human-capital requirements of the farm?

capabilities.name: Workforce Planning & Recruitment
capabilities.focus: Does the farm systematically determine its workforce requirements and recruit appropriate people with the skills and capacity needed to perform farm activities effectively?

capabilities.name: Skills Development & Capacity Building
capabilities.focus: Does the farm continuously develop the knowledge, technical skills, management capability and adaptability of the people responsible for farm operations?

capabilities.name: Farm Operations & Workforce Management
capabilities.focus: Does the farm organise, coordinate, supervise and measure people and daily operations so that work is completed safely, efficiently, consistently and on time?

capabilities.name: Leadership, Culture & Workforce Wellbeing
capabilities.focus: Does the farm provide effective leadership and create a safe, respectful, accountable and motivating work environment that enables people to perform, develop and remain productive over time?

capabilities.name: Market Awareness
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer understand the markets available for their products, who their customers are, what those customers require, and the factors that influence demand, prices and market opportunities?

capabilities.name: Market Access & Customer Relationships
capabilities.focus: Can the farm consistently reach appropriate markets, establish reliable sales channels and build relationships that attract, serve and retain customers?

capabilities.name: Market Intelligence & Competitiveness
capabilities.focus: Does the farm systematically collect, analyse and use market information to understand customers, competitors, prices and trends and make better commercial decisions?

capabilities.name: Value Addition & Market Diversification
capabilities.focus: Does the farm deliberately increase the value of its products and diversify products, customers, channels or markets to improve margins, create new opportunities and reduce market dependence?

capabilities.name: Market Leadership & Strategic Positioning
capabilities.focus: Does the farm have a clear and differentiated market position, strong customer value proposition and long-term strategy for strengthening its competitiveness and market presence?

capabilities.name: Investment Awareness
capabilities.focus: Does the farmer understand why and when a farm business may require capital, the different financing options available, their costs and obligations, and how to make appropriate investment decisions?

capabilities.name: Business Governance & Legal Readiness
capabilities.focus: Is the farm enterprise appropriately structured, governed and legally organised so that ownership, responsibilities, decision-making and accountability are clear?

capabilities.name: Financial & Investment Documentation
capabilities.focus: Can the farm produce reliable financial, operational and business documentation that demonstrates its performance, credibility, capital requirements and ability to responsibly manage external resources?

capabilities.name: Resource Mobilisation & Strategic Partnerships
capabilities.focus: Can the farm identify its financial and non-financial resource gaps, develop compelling propositions and build relationships that help mobilise the resources required to achieve its objectives?

capabilities.name: Enterprise Growth & Investment Readiness
capabilities.focus: Has the farm brought together its business model, governance, financial performance, market opportunity, management capacity and growth strategy into a credible enterprise capable of responsibly absorbing capital and scaling?
